tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ba)༄༅/ /sems bskyed kyi cho ga bsdus pa bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'o nyid cag byang chub kyi mchog tu sems ba
(ba)༄༅/ /sems bskyed kyi cho ga bsdus pa bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'o nyid cag byang chub kyi mchog tu sems ba

tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// sems bskyed kyi cho ga bsdus pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'o nyid cag byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bzhed par gda' bas/ bdag gis sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bgyi/ de la 'o skol thams cad kyis skye ba snga ma la bsod nams bsags pa'i stobs kyis mi'i lus rin po che thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ de ltar gyur pa'i gnas skabs 'dir chos re ma byas/ lam sna re ma zin na tshe la nges pa med pas nam 'chi mi shes/ skye ba la rang dbang ma thob pas gar skye mi shes/ cis kyang 'chi zhing skye ba bzang ngan gang len las dge sdig gi rjes su 'brang ba lags/ da ltar rang dbang yod pa'i skabs 'dir dkar po'i dge ba'i chos re bgyid 'tshal/ chos de'ang bstan pa 'di las phyi rol du gyur pa mu stegs dang*/ sog po la sogs pa'i lam de rnams ston pa 'khor ba las ma grol/ bstan pa nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por mi 'gyur bas/ lam gyi tshul de dag la 'bad pa bgyis kyang mtho ris kyi 'bras bu'ang thob par dka' na/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa smos ci 'tshal/ 'o na lam gang gis grol bar 'gyur na/ 'o skol gyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bdag nyid 'khor ba'i nyes pa las grol/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad/ nyid kyis ji ltar mngon du mdzad pa ltar/ gzhan dag la'ang bstan pas/ ston pa mya ngan las 'da' bar byed pa zhes bgyi ba lags/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas des bstan pa'i chos spyir bsam gyis mi khyab na'ang*/ theg pa che chung gnyis su 'du ba lags par gda' bas/ theg pa chung ngu'i lam gyis rang nyid zhi bar byed tsam ma gtogs pa/ gzhan gyi don rgya chen po dang sangs rgyas thob pa'i gags su 'gyur bas/ theg pa dman par gsungs pa lags/ theg pa chen po 'di bsam pa dang sbyor ba rgya chen pos rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par bgyid pas theg pa chen po'i lam 'di la nan tan du bgyid 'tshal/

theg pa chen po'i de'i gzhi dang lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa yin par gsungs/ de'ang dang por yang dag par blangs pa zhes bgyi ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen las len dgos par gda' na/ nyid cag phal cher gyis sems bskyed pa thob pa lags pas de rnams kyi bag chags gso zhing gsal 'debs pa dang*/ ma thob pa rnams kyis thob par bya ba'i don du/ de ring yang sems bskyed pa bgyid pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsgom/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag la sems bskyed pa gnang bar zhu zhes gsol ba 'debs par bsgoms la bdag gi lad mo mdzod cig rigs kyi bu bdag la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod do// de ltar bgyid pa de khyed kyis bdag la gsol ba btab pa lags/ da bdag gis kyang sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bgyid pa lags/ de la sbyor ba dngos gzhi/ rjes rnam pa gsum yod pa las/ thog mar sbyor ba'i cho ga la bdun yod pa'i ser sna'i las kyi sgrib pa dag par bya ba'i don du dkon mchog mchod pa bgyi/ de la thag mar bkur sti'i mchod pa zhes bya ba phyag 'tshal ba lags pas/ bdag gi lus dpag tu med par sprul la sems can thams cad dang thabs cig tu phyag 'tshal bar bsgoms la/ thal mo sbyor la bdag gi lad mo mdzod cig na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na mas+saṃ ghā ya/ na mas+sarba bud+dha bho dhi sa twā nāṃ/ man+t+ra de wa ta/ oṃ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa thams cad lha rdzas las grub pa/ nam mkha'i khams khyab pas bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum mchod par bsgoms la/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha/ badz+ra pūṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhūp+pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye/ badz+ra shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de rnams mchod pa lags/ da log pa'i skyabs gnas la mos pa'i las kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba dang*/ rten khyad par can la brten pa'i don du skyabs su 'gro ba bgyid pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dus da nas bzung nas ji srid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bsgoms la/ bdag gi lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// de ltar skyabs su song bas skyabs khyad par can dang bcas shing*/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten dang ldan par gyur pa lags/ da sngon bsags kyi sdig pa thams cad dag par bya ba'i don du sdig pa bshags par bgyid pa/ bla ma dang*/ dkon mchog gi spyan sngar bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis sngar byas pa'i sdig pa thams cad bshags/ phyin chad nus tshad kyis bsdam snyam du bsgoms la bdag gi lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur pas/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid kyi sgo gsum nas/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa thams cad so sor bshags shing yang mi bgyid do// zhes lan gsum brjod/

des sdig pa rnams bsrabs shing dag par 'gyur ba lags/ da dge ba'i rtsa ba spel ba'i don du rjes su yi rang ba bgyid pas 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa/ gzhan gyi dge ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang snyam du bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ so so'i skye bo dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o// des rang gi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba lags/ da sems can rnams smin cing grol bar bgyi ba'i don du/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul bar bgyid pas/ rang gi lus dpag tu med par sprul nas/ sems can thams cad dang thabs gcig tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar phyin nas/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa la sogs pa yon du phul nas chos gsung bar zhu bar bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi bzhed pa de dag thams cad la/ sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo zhes lan gsum brjod do// de ltar bskul bas sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos ston par 'gyur ba'i dge ba rang re rnams kyis thob par 'gyur ba lags/ da chos kyi 'khor lo de rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bar bya ba'i don du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa lags pas/ yang rang gi lus dpag tu med par sprul pa dang*/ sems can thams cad dang thabs cig tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar phyin te/

mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis mchod nas/ 'khor ba rgyun ma chad kyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par zhu snyam du bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' bar dgongs pa de dag thams cad la/ 'khor ba srid du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs nas sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad par gsol ba 'debs so zhes lan gsum brjod do// de ltar gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs nas sems can rnams kyi don mdzad par 'gyur ba'i dge ba rang re rnams kyis thob par 'gyur ba lags/ da dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag chud mi 'dza' bar bya ba'i don du cho ga'i rim pa tshang bar bya ba'i phyir bsngo ba bgyid pas dge ba thams cad yongs su bsngo snyam bgyis la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gi mthus/ bdag cag gi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems skye ba dang*/ mthar phyin par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ de ltar bdun po des sbyor ba'i cho ga yan lag bdun pa tshang ba lags/ da dngos gzhi bgyid pa lags/ de la thog mar bsam pa sbyang ba dang*/ bsam pa 'byongs nas dam 'cha' ba gnyis yod pa lags/ de la thog mar bsam pa sbyang ba bgyi bas bdag zer ba bzhin bsgom par zhu/ bdag gi lus dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad la byin pas/ sems can re res kyang yongs su rdzogs par thob nas sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral/ dge ba dang bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan/ myur du 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyur 'gyur bar bsgom par zhu/

des bsam pa sbyang ba lags/ de ltar bsam pa 'byongs nas dam 'cha' ba lags pas/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi snyam du bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas de dag gis sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o zhes lan gsum brjod do// de ltar sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi sgo nas khyed rnams kyis byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa thob pas/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag kun// bder gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

rgyal ba rnams kyi sras byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya bar 'gyur zhing*/ myur du 'tshang rgya ba'i skal ba dang ldan/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang phyag bya ba'i gnas su 'gyur ba lags/ da mjug gi cho ga la gnyis bdog pa'i thog mar rang dga' ba bsgom par bgyi bas/ bdag byang chub sems dpar gyur pa shin tu don che/ da rigs dang mthun pa'i spyod pa la ci nas kyang bslab dgos snyam du bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig de ring bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsam ste// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// de rang dga' ba bsgom pa lags// da gzhan dga' ba bsgom du gzhug par bgyi bas// bdag cag gis sems bskyed pa thob cing*/ byang chub sems dpar gyur pas bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha la sogs pa thams cad dga' bar gyis la/ bdag byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs kyang mdzod ces bskul bar bsgoms la/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dag gi /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes brjod do// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa lags/ de'i bslab par bya ba la nus tshad kyis sdig pa mi byed/ dbang med bya dgos byung na bshags pa bya/ stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam du byang chub kyi sems rgyun du bsgom pa'i bslab par bya ba gal che ba rnams 'du ba lags par gda'/ rgyas par gzhan du mkhyen par mdzad 'tshal/

da dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad chud mi 'dza' zhing mthar phyin par bya ba'i don du bsngo ba bgyi bas/ rang gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsam pa rnam par dag pas bsdus nas sems can thams cad dang thun mong du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo snyam du bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan thams cad gcig tu bsdoms nas sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig de ma thob kyi bar du'ang skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du lha dang mi'i go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur cig yang dag pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su bzung nas don dam pa dang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems zung du 'jug pa rgyud la skyes te pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa bzhi spyad nas/ sa bcu dang lam lnga bgrod de myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// gnas skabs su'ang bdag cag thams cad tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ longs spyod che ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa dang shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
